newsitem.title: INDIA: India MTNL to set up jv with TCIL -paper.
newsitem.headline: India MTNL to set up jv with TCIL -paper.

text.p: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Ltd (MTNL), the state-run telephone monopoly in Bombay and Delhi, will set up a 10-billion-rupee ($280 million) joint venture with Telecommunications Consultants India (TCIL), the Financial Express newspaper said on Tuesday.
The new venture will provide basic cellular and value-added services in India and abroad, the newspaper said.
Both companies have decided to approach the Telecommunications Commission this week for approval, it added.
The newspaper quoted TCIL chairman A.S. Bansal as saying that the proposed company would start operations in less than two years.
The firm will start by providing basic and cellular services in the eastern state of West Bengal and eastern Uttar Pradesh state and then expand its operations to the entire nation, he said.
The two companies are considering various options for raising equity for their proposed joint venture, the newspaper said.
Technical collaboration with a foreign entity was ruled out for the project, it added. -- New Delhi Newsroom (91) 11-301-2024; Fax (91) 11-301-4043 ($=35.7 rupees)
